newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp to settle defraud case - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp to settle defraud case - WSJ.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings is close to reaching an agreement with the U.S. federal government to pay $182 million for allegedly defrauding Medicare by billing it for unnecessary blood tests, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.

The newspaper cited "people familiar with the case" as saying one of its subsidiaries was also expected to plead guilty in the Middle District federal court of North Carolina to criminal charges and pay a $5 million fine.
The settlement with the world's largest clinical laboratory is part of a wider government investigation into unnecessary billing by a number of clinics.
